family: GTK2 GtkEntry: dynamic face color and native selection

implementation.normal_face: A 0.847 shade of the active KDE Header background role, recalculated from every exported palette.
implementation.selection: GtkEntry reverse video uses the active KDE View text/background roles; other selected widgets retain KDE Selection roles.

native_gtk2.command: TMPDIR=$HOME/tempia xvfb-run -a env T04_PRIVATE_ENTRY=1 GTK_MODULES= GDK_BACKEND=x11 I167_RUNTIME_SELECTION_OUTPUT=$HOME/tempia/i167-r129-runtime /usr/bin/python3 -B tools/theme-lab/tests/probe_gtk2_domainos_entry_runtime.py
native_gtk2.result: passed with GTK 2.24.33 on DomainOS, BreezeLight, and BreezeDark

live_guest_observation.reference: Domain/OS SR10.4 with HP VUE 2.01, dedicated clone PID 3759847
live_guest_observation.before: The native screen snapshot was black. A one-frame Shift pulse woke it; the field and existing text a*a became visible.
live_guest_observation.input_cleanup: Shift and Ctrl+A were each released; MAME callbacks report done=true, held=false, error=nil. VM remains unpaused, frameskip=4, throttled=false.
live_guest_observation.selection_attempt: A one-frame Ctrl+A pulse did not yield an auditable VUE selection highlight in the paired field crop. The small change is consistent with caret phase; do not count this as selection proof.

limits: The native run proves that GTK2 paints the role-derived face and selection at runtime; it does not establish the historical VUE color-selection algorithm or visually compare a selected VUE field in the SR10.4 guest.
Xvfb has no window manager; KWin/session integration and human visual acceptance remain open.
The 0.847 shade is an empirically measured role translation, not a static final RGB; validate its visual behavior against the live DomainOS field before closing this GtkEntry stage.
next: Continue GTK2 GtkEntry only: determine a verified, non-destructive way to focus/select the File Name text in the live SR10.4 VUE Find Files window; compare the actual selected field without changing its contents, then close remaining GtkEntry focus/caret/selection gaps before returning to the GTK2 queue.
